items.title: /g/ Technology: Is AGI simply a really advanced indexing software?
items.content_text: Intelligence is not a bloated neural network trying to simulate reasoning. At its absolute limit, general intelligence is simply a super-advanced, ultra-compact, real-time indexing software. If you can index the streaming variables of the physical universe as cleanly, compactly, and directly as Voidtools indexes a hard drive, the data naturally routes itself. You don't need a neural brain to think; the index is the mind.
